summary: GSI Technology filed an 8-K to disclose unaudited preliminary financial results for the fiscal year ended March 31, 2026, including net revenue of approximately $25.1 million and gross margin of about 54.5%. The filing notes that consolidated financials are not yet available and these are preliminary estimates subject to adjustments. No special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC action, or forced management change is described. The filing is a routine current report of financial results and other events, not a special situation.
